notes: Founding-create Welcome sizes for the White Noise profile, measured by marmot-app's tests::relay_event_limits::a_bulk_create_fits_a_known_limit_up_to_the_fixture_boundary_with_device_groups_{off,on} with the real engine, peeler and relay-plane adapter (mdk#2334).

device_groups_off rows are measured with MarmotAppConfig::device_groups off; device_groups_on rows with it on, where every KeyPackage and leaf also advertises the device roster (marmot.account.device-roster.v1), so the Welcome is larger and the boundary can sit at a smaller roster (mdk#3480).
members counts the founder, so a create sends members - 1 gift wraps, one per invitee, all the same size.

mls_welcome_bytes is the MLS Welcome; rumor_json_bytes the kind 444 rumor JSON; seal_json_bytes the kind 13 seal JSON, which is the gift wrap's NIP-44 plaintext; gift_wrap_json_bytes the signed kind 1059 event JSON, the size relays limit and size classes bucket.

Rows: a two-member chat, then the largest roster whose gift wrap fits 64 KiB (65,536 bytes) and the next one up. NIP-44 padding grows the wrap in steps, so the boundary moves only when the codec or the advertised capabilities do.

When they change, the test for that configuration fails and prints the measured rows; replace that configuration's rows with them, keeping the two rosters on either side of 64 KiB. If the boundary itself moved, the test fails before printing (a refused or accepted create); move the two rosters by one member and rerun until it prints.
